title: Finishing Shop Surcharge Notice: Paint-Line Priority on Expedited Factory Production Orders
content:
**Surcharge.** For Factory Production Orders built on an expedited schedule, a paint-line priority add-on is charged on the openings priced on the exterior color change orders of the window contract the order builds:

| Exterior color openings, compared with the units on the order | Add-on |
|---|---|
| at least half of the units | 20 dollars per such opening |
| at least one, but fewer than half of the units | 10 dollars per such opening |
| none | nothing |

The add-on is added to the per-unit charge of the expedite before that sum is compared with the class minimum expedite fee.

## Where the openings are found

The openings come from the Window Replacement Contracts records of the contract the order builds: the change orders of the kind exterior color, each pricing a number of openings, summed across all of them.

## Hypothetical examples

| Units on the order | Exterior color openings | Add-on |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 4 (exactly half) | 4 openings at 20 dollars, 80.00 |
| 8 | 3 | 3 openings at 10 dollars, 30.00 |
| 7 | 4 (above half of 7) | 80.00 |
| 8 | 0 | none |
